propositions: When multiple bundle objects exist for a single S3 ref, git operations fail (clone returns 'multiple updates for ref not allowed', push stalls due to ambiguous ref).
Upstream git_remote_s3 Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive-only (blocking input() calls) and discards non-chosen heads, losing unique events from the append-only store.

S3 doctor must merge divergent bundle heads losslessly via iterated 2-parent git merges (reusing sync._union_merge semantics and .gitattributes merge=ours for .bridge_state/*), never discarding any head.
Heal must write merged bundle before deleting originals and never delete the merged bundle, ensuring at least one full-history bundle survives every crash point.

Heal must serialize with git_remote_s3's acquire_lock/release_lock (conditional-put per-ref lock) and re-enumerate under lock to guard against TOCTOU; backing-off processes on lock-held converge via next push retry.

Push path must auto-detect multi-bundle signatures ('multiple bundles exists' and 'multiple updates for ref') and invoke heal exactly once per push call (healed_once guard), retrying push afterward without infinite non-FF retry loops.
